purpose: Read-only published-class and active-row ownership contracts; not lifetime or mutation authority

reference.verification: Each complete-instruction prefix has exactly one imported match; all default prefixes also uniquely match authenticated disk .text
reference.policies: Slots are data_reference/data_only; reference bodies signature/signature_only, never invoked

class_contract.end_image_native_size: 0x1e8 in BOTH builds; prior default 0x200 detail was incorrect (0x200 is EndPieImage)
class_contract.admission: Authenticate immutable reference and signed RIP target, require existing nonnull published class with registry/class/script-package identity, apply qualified fast ancestry, reread slot and metadata. Names alone are insufficient. Never initialize a null getter. Class publication is not a target lifetime lease.

array.property_kind: 0x16 Array, inner 0x12 ordinary strong Object declared UWidget

current_rows.logical_index: Arrays store pointers only. Song rows retain actual existing setup-hook row/logical-index/session/setup-generation association; pool position is NOT logical index. Uniform SpeedIcon styling needs current membership, not a song index. Invalidate prior association on every rebind.
current_rows.validation: Positive current MusicList and list/row handles; current active array (never CachedWidgets) member plus class, header and member rereads. Each row owns its current WidgetTree via qualified strong fields; SpeedIcon belongs to an admitted current speed row. Preserve native SelectedIndex policy.
current_rows.limits: No independent persistent row logical-index field established; no GUObjectArray scan; current callback authority and full strong containment remain required.

speed_row_lifecycle.update: Resolve current weak SpeedList, native speed ordinal and SpeedIcon, check EndImageSet ancestry, set native SelectedIndex 2/1/0. Does not assign/rebuild Images, WidgetTree or ContentWidgets; native child lookup may populate its cache.

default_setup_witness.scope: Actual speed ordinal, NOT song index or necessarily active-array position. Evidence witnesses only, not qualified new callables.

speed_row_lifecycle.checkpoints: Initial Ready, after the existing owned selection original, and already-qualified theme application boundaries. The owned selection body encloses selection-to-speed-update. piano_detail_update is a different function and does not establish this provenance.
speed_row_lifecycle.uniform_binding: Associate menu generation, current positive SpeedList/row identity and current tree with a locally named membership epoch. Enumerate active strong ContentWidgets, not CachedWidgets; resolve/recheck header/member/tree before writes, retire missing subjects and reconcile replacements. Preserve native Images header/transforms/SelectedIndex. No logical song index or row-state classification is needed.
speed_row_lifecycle.limits: Independent Blueprint RefreshItems is not proven enclosed by the song-row setup hook. Re-resolve at qualified checkpoints; never reuse raw retained row pointers as authority or label a local epoch native setup generation. No new hook or runtime call was qualified by this research.
